Calculate life expectancy at given ages

Source: R/calculate_life_table.R
calculate_life_expectancy.Rd

A convenience wrapper around calculate_life_table() that returns only remaining life expectancy (ex) at the requested ages, for each stratum of the input rates.

Usage

calculate_life_expectancy(rates, age = 0)

Arguments

rates

A table returned by calculate_mortality_rates(), a mortality process object from mortality(), or a data frame with at least age_start, age_end, and rate_mortality or rate columns. Must contain an open-ended age group specified by an Inf value for age_end. Input may be further stratified by other variables.

age

Ages at which to report life expectancy, in years. Each must be the start of an age band in rates. Defaults to 0, life expectancy at birth.

Value

A tibble with the stratifying columns of the input (when supplied), age, and ex, with one row per stratum and requested age.

See also

calculate_life_table()

Examples

calculate_life_expectancy(usa_2000_mortality)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 3
#>   sex     age    ex
#>   <chr> <int> <dbl>
#> 1 f         0  79.4
#> 2 m         0  74.0
calculate_life_expectancy(usa_2000_mortality, age = c(0, 30, 65))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 3
#>   sex     age    ex
#>   <chr> <int> <dbl>
#> 1 f         0  79.4
#> 2 f        30  50.5
#> 3 f        65  19.0
#> 4 m         0  74.0
#> 5 m        30  45.8
#> 6 m        65  16.0
